name: Mahora
source:
Member of the Special Division 3 of the demon supervision unit. He was assigned to the Special Division 3, which is said to be made up of troublesome members, not because he himself is problematic, but because there was no one else who could work with Hozumi. He likes sweets and often writes in his notebook about the ones he eats. He is accompanied by a demon named Shuu. This is known to some members of the Special Division 3. He used to be good friends with Souma.

[Translated from [url=http://lovedelivery.biz/suito/chara.html]the official website[/url].]
